notes.title: From Leather to Plasma: How WoW's Crafting Lives On in Stuck On Earth
notes.content:
What excites us most about WoW’s crafting system is that it allows you to create very useful items starting from materials you can find naturally in the game world while completing quests. Also, once you've maxed out a specific skill, you can craft high-level armor that's useful in both PvP and PvE. I clearly remember all the sessions with my Rogue and the boots I crafted thanks to my leatherworking skill—they let me escape quickly (even if sometimes they exploded and launched me into the air… well, the escape still worked, just in a more dramatic way ːsteammockingː).

Even though Stuck On Earth is a competitive arena game, we wanted to recreate similar mechanics to bring back the same feelings that made us love WoW to this day.

The economy in Stuck On Earth is based on materials. Different resources can be used to craft skins and other items, which, depending on their type, allow the creation of specific objects.

The most common resource is "Silicate Stone", which is required to build any item—but only after combining it with one of the other available materials, like the "Fire Shard", which allows the creation of fire-based items. Or you can combine it with a "Plasma Shard" to create plasma-based items.

There are also more valuable elements, such as ultra-rare metals from planets in other galaxies, which are only accessible during certain special events.

I can’t reveal much more for now… but we’ll show you more soon, promise!

notes.title: They Didn’t Mean to Crash Here…
notes.content:
Stranded, shrunk, and surrounded by clueless humans, they’ve turned Earth into an airborne arena of cosmic chaos.

Pick your alien, master bizarre abilities, and brawl midair in team-based matches where the only rule is: don’t ask why they’re flinging balls at furniture.

notes.title: Goal Shield!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283745/41b8357604185e38f58f236bfb198c07037b053f.gif[/img]

With the patch on 22.11.2024, we introduced the Goal Shield, which delays the initial ball interaction. This gives players more time to focus on gaining an advantage through character combat before the goal is unlocked.

notes.title: Changelog 18.11.2024
notes.content:
With the changelog dated 18.11.2024, the following bugs were fixed:

The character disappearing due to the camera getting stuck inside the character’s body.
Fixed random teleportation that occurred a few seconds after the character was shot from the cannon.

notes.title: Fighting improved!
notes.content:
With the changelog dated 11.11.2024, the overall physics and combat interactions between characters have been improved.
[list]
[*] Added the ability to focus on an enemy
[*] Introduced a stun mechanism triggered upon receiving severe damage improving the fighting mechanism
[*] Fixed all instances of ball teleporting
[*] Improved the physics of the ball-grabbing mechanism
[*] Fixed a bug causing some abilities to trigger too early
[*] Fixed an issue causing animations to terminate incorrectly
[*] Improved texture loading to prevent crashes on low-end devices
[*] Minor gameplay balance adjustments
[/list]
